''' Related NPCs: ''' | Giants |} Kindly faction is required for all Thurgadin armor quests.
== Reward == {{Gear Set |Grand Master's Headband |Grand Master's Chest Wraps |Grand Master's Arm Wraps |Grand Master's Wrist Wraps |Fist of the Grand Master |Grand Master's Leg Wraps |Grand Master's Slippers }} == Checklist == Turn-ins to [[Lorekeeper Einar]] in [[Thurgadin]].{{CheckboxList}} *[[Grand Master's Headband]] :*[[Eroded Leather Cap]] :*3x [[Crushed Coral]] *[[Grand Master's Chest Wraps]] :*[[Eroded Leather Tunic]] :*3x [[Flawless Diamond]] *[[Grand Master's Arm Wraps]] :*[[Eroded Leather Sleeves]] :*3x [[Flawed Emerald]] *[[Grand Master's Wrist Wraps]] :*[[Eroded Leather Bracelet]] :*3x [[Crushed Flame Emerald]] *[[Fist of the Grand Master]] :*[[Eroded Leather Gloves]] :*3x [[Crushed Topaz]] *[[Grand Master's Leg Wraps]] :*[[Eroded Leather Leggings]] :*3x [[Flawed Sea Sapphire]] *[[Grand Master's Slippers]] :*[[Eroded Leather Boots]] :*3x [[Crushed Black Marble]] {{End}} == Walkthrough == Must be at least Kindly. You say, 'Hail, Lorekeeper Einar' Lorekeeper Einar says, 'Greetings to you. I seek one that has chosen the path of monkhood. What do you call yourself?' You say, 'I am a monk' Lorekeeper Einar says, 'Good. I had hoped you were one. I have heard that as seeker of the way you are in constant training to push yourself to your physical and mental limits. It is an admirable quality and I wish to aid you. I will provide you with a cap, a tunic, sleeves, bracers, gloves, leggings and boots.' '''Gems are dropped in various Velious zones while Eroded Leather Armor drops from the higher level giants in Kael Drakkel.''' '''After turn-in:''' Lorekeeper Einar smiles warmly as he hands you your reward. 'You have done well, _____.'
* Your faction standing with [[Coldain]] got better. * Your faction standing with [[Dain Frostreaver IV]] got better. * Your faction standing with [[Kromzek]] got worse. * Your faction standing with [[Kromrif]] got worse.
{{YouGainExperience}} == Cap == ''Dialogue needed.'' Einar promises to make you a cap if you bring him three pieces of [[Crushed Coral]] as well as an [[Eroded Leather Cap]]. == Tunic == ''Dialogue needed.'' Einar promises to make you a tunic if you bring him three [[Flawless Diamond]]s and an [[Eroded Leather Tunic]]. == Sleeves == ''Dialogue needed.'' Einar promises to make you some sleeves if you bring him three [[Flawed Emerald]]s and a set of [[Eroded Leather Sleeves]]. == Bracer == You say, 'I want bracers' Lorekeeper Einar says, 'For the bracers, I will require a [[Eroded Leather Bracelet|eroded leather bracelet]] as well as three [[Crushed Flame Emerald|crushed flame emeralds]]. Return to me when you find such things.' == Gloves == ''Dialogue needed.'' Einar promises to make you some gloves if you bring him three [[Crushed Topaz]] and a pair of [[Eroded Leather Gloves]]. == Leggings == ''Dialogue needed.'' Einar promises to make you some leggings if you bring him a set of old [[Eroded Leather Leggings]] and three [[Flawed Sea Sapphire]]s. == Boots == ''Dialogue needed.'' Einar promises to make you some boots if you bring him three pieces of [[Crushed Black Marble]] and a pair of [[Eroded Leather Boots]].
